title: Orientation and training.
bodyText: To improve the identification of child abuse and neglect, the department shall offer periodic orientation and training to those responsible for making child abuse and neglect reports pursuant to section 350-1.1.
bodyHtml: [§350-1.15]  Orientation and training.  To improve the identification of child abuse and neglect, the department shall offer periodic orientation and training to those responsible for making child abuse and neglect reports pursuant to section 350-1.1. [L 1988, c 323, §1]
